title: Home Purchase Agreement Closing Extensions for Buyers Financing Outside Calloway Home Mortgage
content:
**Lending liaison note.** The base length of a buyer closing extension on a Home Purchase Agreement follows how the buyer is financing, read from the agreement's financing type and from the buyer's Builder Extended Rate Lock records with Calloway Home Mortgage:

- where the agreement's financing type is outside lender and the buyer has withdrawn a Calloway Home Mortgage rate lock (a Builder Extended Rate Lock of the buyer stands in status withdrawn), the base length is **21 calendar days**;
- where the financing type is outside lender and no withdrawn Calloway Home Mortgage rate lock stands, the base length is **18 calendar days**;
- otherwise the financing type does not change the base length.

## Decision table

| Agreement financing type | Withdrawn Builder Extended Rate Lock for the buyer | Base length of the extension |
|---|---|---|
| Outside lender | Yes | 21 calendar days |
| Outside lender | No | 18 calendar days |
| Calloway Home Mortgage | Either | Not changed by financing |
| Cash | Either | Not changed by financing |

## Cases (hypothetical buyers)

- A buyer who withdrew a Builder Extended Rate Lock with Calloway Home Mortgage and now finances with an outside lender: the base length is 21 calendar days.
- A buyer financing with an outside lender who never held a Calloway Home Mortgage rate lock, or whose only rate lock is not withdrawn: 18 calendar days.
- A buyer who withdrew a rate lock but whose agreement shows cash as the financing type: the financing type is not outside lender, so neither 21 nor 18 applies.
